name: Paper Trampoline
author: Addicting Games
description:
Get ready to bounce your way to victory in Paper Trampoline!
In this sketched, paper world, your goal is simple: help the paperman get across each level by carefully placing trampolines in just the right spots. Sounds easy? Think again! As you progress, you'll face increasingly tricky obstacles, dangerous staplers and spike traps, and unique problems that challenge your problem-solving skills.

Are you ready to think outside the page and master the art of the perfect jump? Let the bouncing begin!
